evidence.observation: Tube pressure rises monotonically during growth from 3.04 to 3.33 Torr (k=20→26) while Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm
MFC stable at 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power ~46%
o2_exhaust not installed, so atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: close or step Ar and watch pressure response) to distinguish a seal leak (air ingress) from an exhaust restriction.
